lumbrito.descripcion: Sun cub. The gem on its forehead shines brighter when it wins a race.

leobrasa.descripcion: Its mane catches fire in battle. It trains by roaring into the wind.

ignileon.descripcion: Its mane burns like a bonfire. It runs from dawn to dusk without tiring.

solarion.descripcion: Sun king. They say its crown of fire has never gone out.

solarion_eclipse.descripcion: An eclipsed sun. Its mane burns crimson and it roars louder than ever.

aletin.descripcion: It uses its fin as a sail. It leaps over waves just to see what's behind.

corsario.descripcion: Its fins slice the waves like swords. It swims wrapped in foam.

almirante.descripcion: It wears armored fins. It guides its school through the roughest currents.

leviatan.descripcion: A colossus of coral and plates. A whirlpool follows it wherever it goes.

leviatan_eclipse.descripcion: It comes from the deepest sea. A violet current swirls around it.

brotin.descripcion: Calm cub. If it naps in the sun, the sprout on its head grows a new leaf.

robledo.descripcion: Its first antlers are peeking out. Its root fists never let go.

guardabosque.descripcion: It wears bark and leaves. Its antlers sprout anew every season.

titan_ancestral.descripcion: The forest grows on its back. Its antlers bloom every spring.

titan_eclipse.descripcion: Night guardian of the forest. Its twisted antlers grow into thorns.

mantin.descripcion: It floats like a round cloud. It loves the warm afternoon breeze.

mantabrisa.descripcion: It glides on air currents without moving its fins.

nimbomanta.descripcion: Its night-sky wings sparkle with tiny stars.

soberaya.descripcion: Queen of the high sky. Its ribbon tails paint auroras.

soberaya_eclipse.descripcion: Its scythe-like wings bend gravity around it.

larvin.descripcion: A shy caterpillar that sleeps by day and eats leaves at night.

capullon.descripcion: Its violet cocoon holds a dream that lasts for weeks.

polinoche.descripcion: Its wings shed a dust that makes anyone who breathes it sleepy.

obsidia.descripcion: Its obsidian wings cover the moon when it flies.

obsidia_eclipse.descripcion: Jagged wings and crimson marks. Its dust puts out the light.

ajolin.descripcion: It smiles all the time. Its gills spark when it gets scared.

chispolote.descripcion: It stores electricity in its pink gills.

truenolote.descripcion: When it gets angry, the water around it buzzes.

ajotron.descripcion: Guardian of the lagoons. Its gills are bolts of lightning.

ajotron_eclipse.descripcion: Its violet armor hums with a trapped storm.

caracolin.descripcion: Slow but brave. Its shell is smooth as a river stone.

pedrecol.descripcion: Its shell fills up with pebbles it finds along the way.

murallacol.descripcion: Its rock shell is as hard as a fortress wall.

bastion.descripcion: A walking fortress. The cracks in its shell glow.

bastion_eclipse.descripcion: A sharp basalt shell. Nothing makes it back down.

colibrin.descripcion: A round chick that flaps so fast it hums.

picoespina.descripcion: Its beak is thin as a thorn. It visits a thousand flowers a day.

espinaflor.descripcion: Its leaf wings cut through the air like blades.

florarca.descripcion: A flower bird with a crown of petals. It pollinates whole forests.

florarca_eclipse.descripcion: Its razor leaf wings spin like a whirlwind.

pangolito.descripcion: It curls into a little ball when something surprises it.

prismolin.descripcion: Its scales begin to shine like colored glass.

cuarzolin.descripcion: Each scale is a prism that splits the light.

prismon.descripcion: Guardian of crystal scales. It shines like a rainbow.

prismon_eclipse.descripcion: Sharp scales and a huge armored crystal tail.

gequito.descripcion: Tiny and curious. It climbs any wall without falling.

velogeco.descripcion: It spreads its membranes and glides from tree to tree.

aurogeco.descripcion: Its violet membranes glow like an aurora.

auragon.descripcion: Great glider of the sky. Its tail draws the northern lights.

auragon_eclipse.descripcion: Its jagged membranes flash cyan and magenta.

ermitin.descripcion: It changes shells as it grows. It always looks for the prettiest one.

pinzacho.descripcion: Its golden shell keeps treasures it finds on the beach.

relicario.descripcion: It guards its shell as if it were a sacred chest.

relicon.descripcion: Armored guardian. Its big claw shields its friends.

relicon_eclipse.descripcion: Its siege claw splits the coastal rocks.

orejin.descripcion: Its droopy ears tremble at the slightest noise.

saltaluna.descripcion: It jumps so high it seems to touch the moon.

medialuna.descripcion: The marks on its back change with the phases of the moon.

astaluna.descripcion: A mythical hare with moon antlers. It runs across the night sky.

astaluna_eclipse.descripcion: Thorny antlers and big claws. Violet moons surround it.

pulpin.descripcion: Shy. It squirts a little ink when someone looks at it.

tintapus.descripcion: It draws pictures in the sand with its tentacles.

abisopus.descripcion: It lives in the deep sea, where light never reaches.

regiopus.descripcion: Ruler of the abyss. Its mantle looks like a crown.

regiopus_eclipse.descripcion: Its abyssal ink darkens the whole sea.

fenequin.descripcion: Its droopy ears warm up when it's happy.

dunafen.descripcion: It runs across the dunes without leaving footprints.

vitrifen.descripcion: Its tail is made of sun glass and glows like a lantern.

vitreon.descripcion: It focuses desert light through its crystal ears.

vitreon_eclipse.descripcion: Its glass turned to obsidian; it burns without giving light.

escarlito.descripcion: It rolls like an ember when it gets scared.

yunquero.descripcion: Its shell rings like an anvil when it collides.

cornifragua.descripcion: It forges its horn red-hot every dawn.

fundaris.descripcion: Its armor is a forge that never goes out.

fundaris_eclipse.descripcion: Its smoky wings hide a magma furnace.

carbunin.descripcion: Its quills are warm as freshly cooled embers.

ascuespin.descripcion: It curls into a ball and rolls, throwing sparks.

pirapuas.descripcion: Each quill holds a burning coal.

carbunco.descripcion: Its fan of quills glows like a sleeping volcano.

carbunco_eclipse.descripcion: Its obsidian quills slice the air with heat.

chispollo.descripcion: It chirps loudly to make the sun come up.

gallarete.descripcion: Its crest throws sparks when it crows.

crestallama.descripcion: Its tail feathers burn like torches.

cometon.descripcion: It crosses the sky leaving a comet trail.

cometon_eclipse.descripcion: Its trail is red and black, like a comet at night.

nutrin.descripcion: It never lets go of its favorite coral stone.

coralutra.descripcion: It sleeps floating belly-up among the corals.

arrecifa.descripcion: It looks after the reef and knows every fish.

nutrarca.descripcion: Its coral tail protects the whole reef.

nutrarca_eclipse.descripcion: The coral of its armor turned crimson.

hipin.descripcion: It holds on to seaweed with its tail so it won't drift away.

hipalet.descripcion: It swims in spirals and leaves silver bubbles.

crestamar.descripcion: Its silver crest glows in dark water.

abisalio.descripcion: Its fan-shaped fins move entire currents.

abisalio_eclipse.descripcion: Its fins are violet blades from the abyss.

medusin.descripcion: It floats calmly and glows when someone says hi.

campanela.descripcion: Its bell rings softly when a wave rises.

medusperla.descripcion: The pearls on its tentacles tickle.

carillon.descripcion: Its chime calms the storms at sea.

carillon_eclipse.descripcion: Its bell rings deep and makes the water tremble.

narvalin.descripcion: Its tusk is still a tiny button of ice.

colmillar.descripcion: It breaks the frost with the tip of its tusk.

glacior.descripcion: It opens paths between icebergs with its great tusk.

glacior_eclipse.descripcion: Its tusk is black ice that reflects no light.

tapirin.descripcion: Its stripes hide it among the moss.

musgapir.descripcion: Mushrooms grow on its back when it rains.

hongotapir.descripcion: Its shelf mushrooms are home to insects.

micelon.descripcion: A whole forest lives on its bark-covered back.

micelon_eclipse.descripcion: Its mushrooms glow violet in the dark.

ninfin.descripcion: It stays still like a flower to play hide-and-seek.

orquiman.descripcion: Its arms look like petals, but they cut leaves.

orquimantis.descripcion: It dances among flowers without anyone noticing.

orquira.descripcion: Its petal wings open like a giant orchid.

orquira_eclipse.descripcion: Its crimson petals cut like scythes.

capibin.descripcion: It gets along with everyone, even crocodiles.

raicibara.descripcion: A little plant grows on its head and it takes great care of it.

manglaron.descripcion: Its roots anchor it to the mangrove water.

raigon.descripcion: It guards the mangrove with roots older than the river.

raigon_eclipse.descripcion: Its roots turned black as the bottom of the swamp.

ramitin.descripcion: It looks like a twig; no one knows how many live in one tree.

bambulito.descripcion: Its bamboo body sounds hollow when you tap it.

bambucan.descripcion: Bamboo leaves grow on its back.

bambuzal.descripcion: Its leaf wings stir up storms in the forest.

bambuzal_eclipse.descripcion: Its bamboo turned black and its leaves, razor sharp.

pavito.descripcion: It has no tail yet, but it already struts proudly.

plumasol.descripcion: Its first feathers have little golden eyes.

abanicor.descripcion: It opens its fan and the feathers crackle.

heliavo.descripcion: Its fan of ivory and gold shines like the sun.

heliavo_eclipse.descripcion: The eyes on its fan stare with violet light.

carpin.descripcion: It glows a little when it swims to the surface.

farolin.descripcion: It carries a tiny light on its forehead so it won't get lost.

lucicarpa.descripcion: Its ribbon fins leave trails of light.

faroluz.descripcion: Its golden whiskers guide ships at night.

faroluz_eclipse.descripcion: Its lantern turned violet and buzzes with electricity.

chinchin.descripcion: Its fur is so soft it gives you a shock when you touch it.

prismilla.descripcion: It rolls in dust to charge up its fur.

cuarzilla.descripcion: Quartz crystals grow on its tail.

prismora.descripcion: Its crystals split light into a thousand colors.

prismora_eclipse.descripcion: Its quartz turned violet and crackles.

golondrin.descripcion: It learns to fly by hopping from branch to branch.

albavuelo.descripcion: It flies just above the water without wetting its wings.

rasalba.descripcion: It heralds spring with its scissor tail.

albalis.descripcion: Its radiant wings bring the first ray of the day.

albalis_eclipse.descripcion: It flies so fast it leaves a trail of night.

buhito.descripcion: It sleeps all day and opens one eye if it hears a noise.

ululin.descripcion: It turns its head to look in every direction.

umbralon.descripcion: It watches over the forest from the highest branch.

umbrus.descripcion: Its huge wings make no sound at all when it flies.

umbrus_eclipse.descripcion: Its eyes glow like two violet moons.

murcito.descripcion: It wraps itself in its wings like a blanket.

velurci.descripcion: Its velvet wings are super soft.

alanoche.descripcion: It finds its way in the dark with its echo.

vespero.descripcion: It rules the night with its great violet wings.

vespero_eclipse.descripcion: Its echo sounds like thunder in the cave.

topin.descripcion: Its star-shaped nose sniffs out gemstones.

excavito.descripcion: It digs tunnels faster than you can walk.

amatopo.descripcion: Amethysts grow on its back as it digs.

geodon.descripcion: Its shell is a giant geode full of crystals.

geodon_eclipse.descripcion: Its amethysts darkened like the center of the earth.

mapachin.descripcion: It always carries a shiny pebble in its paws.

onixito.descripcion: It hides treasures in holes in the rocks.

anillonix.descripcion: Its ringed tail has veins of onyx.

onixor.descripcion: It guards a cave full of polished stones.

onixor_eclipse.descripcion: Its onyx turned black and its gaze, violet.

caldrak.descripcion: Cauldron crocodile. Its basalt scales hold rivers of lava.

ferrandra.descripcion: Forge salamander. Its tail fans the air into flames like bellows.

talasor.descripcion: Abyssal eel. It swims in spirals and bites from the darkness.

borealmo.descripcion: Glacial walrus. Slow as an iceberg and just as hard to move.

zarzabal.descripcion: Bramble boar. It charges nonstop through thorns and roots.

micervido.descripcion: Mycelium stag. Glowing spores sprout from its antlers.

fulgarok.descripcion: Storm bison. Every step leaves thunder behind.

najasol.descripcion: Prism cobra. It splits light into rays that can't be dodged.

astracorno.descripcion: Meteor ibex. Its horns are pieces of a fallen star.

geodracnida.descripcion: Geode spider. It weaves crystal webs inside its cave.

tempestario.descripcion: Storm albatross. It soars over the eye of the hurricane, unshaken.

cicloptero.descripcion: Cyclone pterosaur. One flap of its wings makes a whirlwind.

umbrafauce.descripcion: Saber-toothed panther. It strikes from the shadows, never head-on.

negralith.descripcion: Void scorpion. Its stinger snuffs out everything it touches.

bastion_de_ceniza.descripcion: Volcano guardian. A basalt tortoise: nothing gets through its shell.

custodio_de_las_mareas.descripcion: Reef guardian. An ancient nautilus that commands the tides.

raiz_primordial.descripcion: Forest guardian. An elephant covered in roots older than the trees.

vigia_del_sol_sepulto.descripcion: Desert guardian. A sun jackal that guards the buried sun.

centinela_del_ultimo_hielo.descripcion: Summit guardian. A glacial gorilla watching over the last ice.

custodio_del_umbral.descripcion: Ruins guardian. An ancient heron before the door that won't open.

terin.descripcion: A long-clawed hatchling. It combs the soil for sweet roots.

teribrote.descripcion: Leaves sprout on its back. It sleeps standing up among the ferns.

verdigarra.descripcion: Its claws slice through thick roots as if they were grass.

verdicron.descripcion: Undying guardian of underground life. A forest grows wherever it steps.

plesin.descripcion: It swims in cave pools. Its neck stretches whenever it is curious.

ondaples.descripcion: It paddles its flippers like oars. It sings to call the currents.

plesiomar.descripcion: It roams underground lakes that no map has ever charted.

nereidon.descripcion: Undying deity of the deep waters. The tides obey its song.

triclin.descripcion: Its frill sparks when startled. It headbutts crystals for fun.

tricorayo.descripcion: It stores electricity in its horns and releases it when it charges.

voltaceratops.descripcion: Its crystal frill draws in every lightning bolt in the cave.

triceraion.descripcion: Eternal guardian of the crystals. A single step makes the ground thunder.

tirin.descripcion: It bites everything it finds. Its teeth are already warm at birth.

tirascua.descripcion: Its tail leaves embers behind as it sweeps the cave floor.

rexbrasa.descripcion: It roars inside volcanoes to wake the magma.

ignirrex.descripcion: Ancient deity of fire. Its roar carved the rivers of lava.

dimlin.descripcion: It warms itself under glowing mushrooms. Its sail changes color.

veloscuro.descripcion: It vanishes into the dark by dimming the glow of its sail.

dimetombra.descripcion: The markings on its sail form maps of the abyss.

noxmetrodon.descripcion: Undying deity of Shadow. Its sail holds a sky full of stars.

anomalo_1.descripcion: A hatchling of the first ocean. Its stalk eyes watch everything with curiosity.

anomalo_2.descripcion: It ripples its side flaps and hunts small fish with its two hooks.

anomalo_3.descripcion: The most feared hunter of the ancient sea. Its spiny hooks never let go.

anomalo_4.descripcion: Guardian of the first ocean. Its flaps shine like sails of amber.

meganeura_1.descripcion: A swamp nymph. Its wing buds spark when it is happy.

meganeura_2.descripcion: It tries out its four wings and buzzes among the giant ferns.

meganeura_3.descripcion: A huge dragonfly. The veins of its wings store electricity.

meganeura_4.descripcion: Guardian of the giant forest storms. Its wings are living stained glass.

estego_1.descripcion: Little leaves sprout instead of plates. It wags its tail while eating.

estego_2.descripcion: Its plates are big leaves that follow the sun all day.

estego_3.descripcion: Its plates hardened like autumn leaves. Nobody goes near its tail.

estego_4.descripcion: Guardian of the Jurassic herd. It carries a whole forest on its back.

ptero_1.descripcion: It can't fly yet, but it jumps off rocks flapping its little wings.

ptero_2.descripcion: It glides over the cliffs looking for warm air currents.

ptero_3.descripcion: A great sunset glider. Its crest cuts through the wind.

ptero_4.descripcion: Guardian of the last sky. It crosses the sunset with a comet trail.

mamut_1.descripcion: A round woolly calf. It curls its trunk to sleep.

mamut_2.descripcion: Frost sticks to its fur and it doesn't even notice.

mamut_3.descripcion: It carries rock and ice tangled in its fur. Its steps shake the tundra.

mamut_4.descripcion: Guardian of the Ice Age. Its ice tusks hold amber.

arquitecto.descripcion: Origin of the Eclipse. It wants a still, colorless world: a blank canvas.

carta_muralla.descripcion: In battle: Defense +2 while it stays on the field.

carta_mente.descripcion: In battle: Sp. Attack +2 while it stays on the field.

carta_calma.descripcion: In battle: Sp. Defense +2 while it stays on the field.

carta_rafaga.descripcion: In battle: Speed +2 while it stays on the field.

encanto_sueno.descripcion: In battle: puts the foe to sleep.

piedra_eclipse.descripcion: Makes a night evolution possible. Used up on use.

amuleto_fuerza.descripcion: Attack +10 % while held. Equip it in My creatures.
